messages.subject: Docs and quick=TRUE
parts:
The manual says:

quick: 

if TRUE skips docs, multiple-architectures, demos, and vignettes, to make installation as fast as possible.

What exactly means "skips docs?" I can still load the manual pages:

install_github("plyr")
library(plyr)
?ddply

Does "skip docs" only refer to rendering of static html docs?
